claim: FastWeightPlasticity (psi/theta decoupling) achieves superior backward transfer compared to replay buffer at matched total memory on Split-MNIST (5 binary tasks) under task-incremental protocol with capacity-limited probe (hidden_dim=32). This re-test uses verified arms (all 6 arms reach >=95% single-task MNIST after bug fixes in Session 23).
memory_matching: replay buffer capacity matched to fast weight plastic state memory footprint at hidden_dim=32
note: Re-test of Phase 2 CL flagship after Session 23 arm bug fixes (nudged-target indexing, max_steps=3->30, SI/LwF no-op). Previous null (Session 21) was based on broken arms and is superseded. Probe is capacity-limited (hidden=32, 2 epochs) to discriminate forgetting.
